$comment: Roadmap 85 eval set (owner 2026-11-01): ~20 spoken requests, the same scene (scene.json), scored pass / partial / fail by every release that changes connector tools. `pass` = any of these calls is made (tool + action when a family) without a refused call before it; `partial` = it gets there after a refused / wrong call, or makes one of `partial`; anything else = fail. Read-only calls (list_scene, status, screenshot, where_are_users, describe_node_types, what_can_you_do, the family read actions) never count against a request.
